profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer & Systems Architect | Edge-to-Cloud Platforms for Hardware & Manufacturing | C++ · .NET · AWS · IoT Telemetry · Computer Vision | Building Toward Applied AI
profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
profile.summary:
I build the software that connects physical machines to the cloud and makes the data those machines produce something you can actually trust.
  
For most of the last decade I’ve worked where hardware, manufacturing, and cloud meet: the point where a sensor on a factory floor has to become reliable data in an AWS warehouse, and where a physical product has to be tested, calibrated, and shipped with zero defects. That space rewards range - native systems programming one day, cloud data pipelines the next, a full-stack app the day after and range is what I bring.
  
A few things I’ve designed and delivered end-to-end:
  
▸ A cross-platform C++ telemetry library (Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android) that captures hardware test data from 30+ machine models and streams it to AWS in real time, with offline resilience, deployed live in an overseas contract-manufacturing facility.
  
▸ A cross-platform diagnostics & end-of-line testing platform combining a native C++/JNI core, OpenCV computer vision, firmware pipelines, and precision calibration across global production and refurbishment lines.
  
▸ A .NET 8 backend API and desktop application: Clean Architecture, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, OAuth2, built to bring a previously outsourced operation fully in-house.
  
▸ Customer-facing and analytics tooling: enterprise support apps integrating Salesforce Commerce and SAP, an Angular gateway on AWS, and manufacturing dashboards on a cloud data warehouse.
  
The throughline is ownership: I take problems from architecture through deployment and production support, and I care most about the unglamorous parts, failure modes, data integrity, the details that decide whether a system is genuinely trusted in production.
  
My roots are in computer vision and machine learning: years ago I built neural-network and image-processing systems for medical and agricultural diagnostics and I’m now bringing that foundation back to the edge-to-cloud world: predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, and AI-assisted tooling on top of the manufacturing telemetry I already build. It’s the natural next layer, systems that don’t just report what happened, but anticipate it.
  
Core stack: C++ · C# / .NET 8 · Python · AWS (Kinesis, Redshift, S3, CloudFront) · Kubernetes · Docker · PostgreSQL · Protobuf · OpenCV · Angular · Flutter · OAuth2 · CI/CD.
  
Always glad to trade ideas with people working on industrial IoT, edge-to-cloud systems, manufacturing software, or applied AI in the physical world.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architect and build edge-to-cloud platforms that connect factory-floor hardware to AWS and ensure the manufacturing data behind production decisions is accurate and trusted. Operate end-to-end — architecture through deployment and production support — across native, cloud, web, and data systems.
  
•   Architected and shipped a cross-platform C++17 telemetry library (Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android) capturing hardware test data from 30+ machine models and streaming it to AWS Kinesis → Redshift in real time, with offline resilience and Protobuf schemas; traveled internationally to deploy it in a live contract-manufacturing facility.
  
•   Led architecture and ownership of a cross-platform diagnostics and end-of-line testing platform (native C++/JNI core, OpenCV computer vision, firmware and calibration pipelines) running across global production and refurbishment lines.
  
•   Designed and built — as sole developer — a .NET 8 backend API and companion desktop application (Clean Architecture, PostgreSQL, EF Core, Docker, Kubernetes, OAuth2/PKCE) to bring a previously outsourced operation fully in-house.
  
•   Built an enterprise support application integrating Salesforce Commerce, SAP, and Auth0 into a single agent console, plus an Angular 18 authenticated gateway deployed on AWS S3/CloudFront via OIDC CI/CD.
  
•   Designed manufacturing-analytics dashboards on a Redshift data warehouse and a controlled auto-update / release-management system (targeted rollouts, mandatory-update enforcement, SHA-256 integrity verification) across globally distributed machines.
  
•   Act as a technical bridge across Manufacturing, Data Engineering, SRE, IT, and Member Care teams, plus external manufacturing partners, to deliver durable, production-ready systems.
  
Earlier at Cricut: Software QA Engineer and Software Engineer (2020–2021), contributing to the .NET backend platform powering Design Space client applications.

positions.title: Senior Technical Manager
positions.description:
Led an offshore team building and maintaining the .NET Web API backend that powered Cricut’s Design Space clients across Windows, Android, and iOS.
  
•   Owned project planning, technical specifications, and delivery for a high-complexity, multi-team API platform using Azure DevOps / TFS.
  
•   Designed and built RESTful services with ASP.NET and SQL Server; led sprint planning, code review, and mentoring for the offshore team.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
Led a team of 10 delivering enterprise and applied machine-learning / computer-vision software across Android, Java, and .NET.
  
•   Led development of a neural-network decision-support system for early breast-cancer detection from digital mammograms — foundational ML / computer-vision work.
  
•   Directed image-processing solutions including content-based image retrieval and a cloud-assisted crop-disease classification system on Android.
  
•   Established engineering practices — code reviews, CI, automated testing, and Agile delivery — across the team.
